title: Building – Performance Platform and Requirement of Sprinkler Deluge System June 2012
description: A theatre company's building had a raised performance platform. The municipality treated it as a 'stage' requiring a sprinkler deluge system and venting at the proscenium opening.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an order; definitional interpretation

outcome_summary: Order revoked: the platform does not meet the Div A definition of 'Stage', so the deluge requirements do not apply.
